title: Picking and Placing in Order: A State Machine With a Check After Every Step That Can Fail

questions.question: Why is a pick a state machine and not a script?
options: A script cannot be tested without a robot
Each step can fail and the next step depends on whether it did
A state machine runs faster on a controller
The steps happen in a different order each time
questions.explanation: A script goes on to the next line whatever happened. After closing, the hand may hold the part, nothing, or the wrong thing, and what to do next differs.

questions.question: A hand closed on nothing has a gap:
options: The same as the part's width
Half the part's width
Near zero
Whatever it was before it closed
questions.explanation: With nothing between them the fingers meet. A gap of the part's width, within a tolerance, is what says the grasp worked.

questions.question: A hand that missed every time stopped in fault:
options: It did not stop: it went on trying
questions.explanation: Three tries are allowed, and then the machine stops in fault 1, no part. Fault 2 is a dropped part and fault 3 a move that took too long.

questions.question: A part that fell on the way was noticed:
options: When the hand opened at the place
After the time limit of the transit ran out
Only if it fell during the lift
At once, from the gap
questions.explanation: The gap is checked at every tick while the part is carried. The moment it closes to nothing the machine stops in fault 2.

questions.question: Why does every state have a time limit?
options: So that the cycle time is the same every run
Because the hand overheats if held closed
To give the planner time to answer
A move that never arrives would hold the machine for ever
questions.explanation: The machine waits for the arm to report that it has arrived. If that never comes, the limit is what ends the wait, in fault 3.

questions.question: Does the machine know where the part is?
options: Yes: it holds the part's position from the camera
Yes, once the first pick has succeeded
No: a target is a number that a planner turns into a motion
Only while the hand is closed
questions.explanation: It is given what was sensed and returns a target and a hand command. It holds no robot and no map, which is why a small test world is enough.
